goal: Desktop 标签按项目自动分组且保持可用

findings.body: P2 blocking: syncTabProjects compares a full project title against candidate.name but writes title.slice(0,80). Renaming an open project to an 81-character valid title causes every subsequent identical sync to write again. Actual vitest repro: nameLength=80, sameWorkspace=false, sameTabs=false; identity-stability assertion fails. useTabProjectSync subjects memo depends on tabs, and its effect depends on subjects; each write produces new tabs via map, so the effect feeds itself repeatedly. Server project create/update impose no 80-character guard. Normalize before comparison (or preserve full project name), add store idempotence and hook convergence regression test. Existing 142 tab-store/tab-bar tests pass.
